subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals be resolved by the bounded 70s actionable-timeout design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498, or should this issue instead require a longer or configurable approval TTL?
rationale: Both approaches affect how long generated-skill apply approval remains actionable and what the agent sees on expiry, which is a security and operator-UX policy choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Use the bounded approval design
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix if PR review clears its security and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Choose a longer TTL
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on a longer fixed or configurable approval window and require new tests and live proof for that security boundary.

options.title: Split timeout from popup UX
options.body: Land only the watchdog-safe timeout result here and leave richer proposal details or configurable TTL to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93173.

recommendation.title: Use the bounded approval design
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix if PR review clears its security and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the issue and authored the current broad candidate PR that closes the timeout and approval-popup cluster.
